chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel; who they are.
chapter_note: A remarkably clean substrate chapter. The teaching is a systematic three-fold emanation hierarchy (gods, rich ones, angels) mapped across three domains: eternal archetypes, cosmic agents in the contest, and eschatological households. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system throughout. The only non-substrate material is dialogue frame attribution (¶2 fully, and frame formulas in ¶1, ¶3, ¶7, ¶10). No editorial bridge, no exhortation, no institutional extension. The seam flag on ¶10 is a false positive — the third application maps to cosmic households (Great Spirit, Beloved of the Lights, Ambassador), not to institutional structures. The order shift in the third application (god→angel→rich instead of god→rich→angel) may reflect intentional mapping to three emanation series (descent, creation, redemption). Teaching purity is high and editorial fatigue is minimal.

paragraphs.core_text: This one, a name is given to him in the world. For people pronounce it with their mouths: 'god', 'rich one', and 'angel'. Who are they? Who are the gods? Or who are the rich ones? Or who are the angels? Who are these [three] archetypes?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Once again the enlightener speaks:' — dialogue frame attribution formula.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The substantive cosmological question defines the entire teaching structure: three names mapped to three archetypes. This is the teaching's own self-description and belongs to the substrate. The frame formula is standard editorial attribution.
Pure formulaic disciple question with no cosmological content. 'Tell us, our master, who they are!' adds no information beyond what ¶1 already established.

paragraphs.core_text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'The apostle speaks to them:' — dialogue frame attribution formula.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The teaching declaration situates the three archetypes in the land of light. The lacuna contains restoration. The 'no measure' formula is a recurrent substrate marker for the infinite nature of light-realm entities.

paragraphs.core_text: So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First element of the three-fold emanation hierarchy at the archetype level. Gods = direct emanation from the Father. 'Summoned from himself' is the evocation formula. Both sides of the mapping stay within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ ... ]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second element: rich ones = second-order evocations. The teaching explains the emanation chain: Father summons gods, gods summon evocations called 'rich'. The lacuna in 'rich [...]' is manuscript damage. 'Conversely' is a substrate structural transition marker.

paragraphs.core_text: They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third element completing the archetype-level hierarchy: angels = third-order evocations. The closing statement ('These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light') frames the first application as complete, a structural closure typical of substrate teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Once again, listen!' — imperative transitional address to audience, not cosmos→cosmos mapping.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins the second application: the three categories mapped to cosmic agents who entered the contest. Gods at this level = emanations who came forth to the cosmic conflict. 'Contest' and 'enmity' are cosmic-drama vocabulary. Both sides remain within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second element of the cosmic-agent level. Rich ones = evocations of the 'first living words' (the gods of ¶7). 'Worlds that are above and below' is systematic cosmic geography. 'Conversely' again serves as substrate structural marker.

paragraphs.core_text: On the other hand, the ones who are named the 'angels' are the evocations of the rich ones, who had come from the three living words. They have been sent in an embassy and an apostolate to this building. They have come to the entire divinity, which is established in silence and in hiddenness. And, also, they have come to all the souls who have been entangled in the enemy. They have brought them hope and confidence.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third element completing the cosmic-agent level. 'This building' = the cosmos (standard Manichaean cosmological term). 'Divinity established in silence and hiddenness' = the trapped light. 'Souls entangled in the enemy' = cosmic bondage. All referents stay within the cosmic system. The 'embassy and apostolate' vocabulary has institutional overtones but here describes cosmic function — the sending of angels to the mixed cosmos. The institutional score (5.19) is a vocabulary false positive.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Once again the enlightener speaks:' — dialogue frame attribution formula.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins the third application: categories mapped to eschatological households. The seam flag fires due to 'Once again the enlightener speaks' + pattern extension, but the content maps gods→Great Spirit's household — both sides remain within the cosmic system. The Great Spirit is a cosmic figure (first emanation series), not an institutional entity. False positive seam detection.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second element of the household-level mapping. Note the order shift: god→angel→rich instead of the earlier god→rich→angel. The Beloved of the Lights belongs to the creation series of emanations. Cosmos→cosmos mapping intact.

paragraphs.core_text: The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third element completing the household-level mapping. The Ambassador belongs to the redemption series. The chapter closes cleanly with the third iteration complete — no editorial tail, no exhortation. The reordering across the three applications (god-rich-angel at archetype level, god-rich-angel at cosmic level, god-angel-rich at household level) may reflect deliberate mapping to different emanation series.
